name: team_task_update
description: Compare-and-set a shared task action using the latest revision from team_task_get or team_task_list. Owners and the Team Lead mutate their tasks; only the Lead reassigns.

expected_revision.description: Current task revision used as the CAS precondition.

write_scopes.description: Replacement workspace-relative write scopes for edit. Omit to keep current scopes; [] clears them.

owner.description: Agent name of the root or any continuable descendant for root-only reassign; omit to unassign.

prompt: Team shared task board: create, read, list, and compare-and-set tasks across the subagent tree. Claim a ready task with its current revision, do the work, then complete it. Dependencies gate claims; write scopes are advisory, not a lock.
